name: Headhunting
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nimboya seeks news of Yenniku, the Darkspear chieftain's son. He sends you to hunt Bloodscalp headhunters and bring back their shrunken heads, hoping to learn whether Yenniku is dead.

sections.title: Searching the Trophies
sections.body:
Nimboya fears the Bloodscalp tribe may have killed Yenniku, the Darkspear chieftain's son. The search began with Hunt for Yenniku, and now he sends you after Bloodscalp Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda along Stranglethorn Vale's northern coast.

Bring back twenty shrunken heads. Nimboya will inspect them for signs that Yenniku met a violent end. If the youth is dead, Nimboya curses Gan'zulah, chief of the Bloodscalp.

faq.answer: Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp searches for Yenniku, the son of the Darkspear tribe's chieftain.

faq.q: Why does Nimboya want shrunken heads?
aliases: what does nimboya do with heads
faq.answer: Nimboya will inspect shrunken heads taken from Bloodscalp headhunters to learn whether Yenniku's head is among their trophies.

faq.q: Where can the Bloodscalp Headhunters be found?
faq.answer: Bloodscalp Headhunters gather along Stranglethorn Vale's northern coast, especially around the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda.

faq.q: Who leads the Bloodscalp tribe mentioned here?
faq.answer: Chief Gan'zulah leads the Bloodscalp tribe. If Yenniku is dead, Nimboya wishes a six-hundred-year curse upon Gan'zulah's spirit.

angles.text: As a troll, you share the Darkspear's concern for the chieftain's son. The Darkspear must face the Bloodscalp tribe to learn what happened to him.
As a member of the Horde, you help your Darkspear allies at Grom'gol Base Camp discover whether their chieftain's missing son still lives.
